expect.note: Design question: the Figma loading variants are 8px wider than the default (the spinner joins the auto-layout row); the button keeps its default width so the layout does not move when loading starts, as mud-service-button did. The pixel diff reports that width.
Figma 2925:5410 shows only the spinner; the logo keeps its width.
Figma loading variants center the spinner component 44:430 (Size=Small), 20x20.
